dct_description_sm: Dataset for experiments related to developing integrated pest management strategies for cannabis production. It includes data on the life history of Cannabis aphid (Phorodon cannabis Passerini) that was assessed on leaf discs and rooted cuttings of multiple drug-type cannabis cultivars. Fecundity (number of offspring produced) and pre-reproductive period (time from birth until first offspring produced) were measured as well as the number of days offspring were produced. The effectiveness of parasitoids and hot water treatments were determined to develop management recommendations
